title: Convergence of Timed-Metric Spaces and Causality
summary: We introduce the notion of timed-Gromov--Hausdorff distance for timed-metric spaces. We prove that this distance is bi-Lipschitz equivalent to the intrinsic timed-Hausdorff distance of Sakovich--Sormani, and therefore induces the same notion of convergence. We establish a compactness theorem for the timed Gromov--Hausdorff distance, obtained as a straightforward consequence of Gromov's classical compactness theorem.
